calls.statement:
SELECT status, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_ids, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test'
),
dup AS (SELECT count(*) AS dup_ids FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM o) AS orders_non_cancelled,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM o) AS distinct_orders,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM t) AS test_orders,
       (SELECT dup_ids FROM dup) AS dup_ids_all_time,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM o WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS no_lines,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM o WHERE member_key IS NULL AND login_state='logged_in') AS odd_login
